table_contract.unmatched_policy: Retain every sales occurrence; missing costs remain blank
table_contract.duplicate_policy: Keep duplicate sales occurrences; reject duplicate product_id/year cost keys
table_contract.null_policy: Null keys do not match; missing cost is not zero

table_contract.missing_column_policy: Fill missing optional fields with blank, never zero
table_contract.duplicate_policy: Preserve every record occurrence; identical rows remain duplicated
table_contract.null_policy: Retain source blanks and distinguish blank from zero
table_contract.order_policy: East records then West records; preserve order within each table

table_contract.routing_policy: region=East goes to east_output; region=West goes to west_output
table_contract.unassigned_policy: Reject input with missing or unknown region; never silently drop rows
table_contract.duplicate_policy: Preserve duplicate record occurrences in their assigned output
table_contract.null_policy: Blank region is an input-contract error
table_contract.order_policy: Preserve original relative order within each output

table_contract.reconstruction_policy: Join on unique non-null source record_id to recover every original record and field
table_contract.duplicate_policy: Repeated business facts with different record_id are preserved; duplicate record_id is invalid
table_contract.null_policy: record_id cannot be blank; payload blanks are preserved
table_contract.order_policy: Preserve source record_id order in both outputs
